outcome: Excluding installs: 2 passed, 4 failed, 1 unsupported, 89 unreached. Both debug initial landscape cases pass; held rotation fails at 1x and is unsupported at 2x; 2x portrait reachability fails. Optimized 1x attribution guard fails and 2x Ready times out; both retain missing-JNI SIGABRT evidence. All 3D is unreached.
limits: Two MP4s remain unqualified. No before-UP, native pixel-privacy, successful failed/unsupported transition, or full native acceptance credit.
